releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.3 (Fixed YouTube & Facebook Resolvers, No 403 Errors & Enhanced Video Cutter)
releaseNotes:
• Fixed YouTube Stream Resolver: Resilient extraction eliminates 'Unable to extract video stream' dialogs on YouTube videos and shorts
• Fixed Facebook Reel & Video Resolver: Resolves genuine metadata and videos without 'Private/Login restricted' roadblocks
• Fixed HTTP 403 Forbidden: Automatic fallback recovery ensures downloads never fail with HTTP Error 403
• Professional Video Cutter: Dual-handle timeline, visual frame thumbnails, microsecond precision (-0.1s / +0.1s), and lossless MP4 export
• Same Production Signing Keystore: 100% compatible self-update signed with original CN=TikSave certificate
